item.description: “The daughter of a steelworker, born and raised in a working-class community outside Buffalo, Kathy Hochul embodies Upstate New York’s grit and determination,” Riley said. item.title: SQSPCA Becomes First in NYS To Pass Companion Animal Care Standards Act Inspection
item.description: The comprehensive review included a walkthrough of the shelter facility to ensure compliance with new statewide standards, with close attention paid to staff and volunteer training, cage and kennel space requirements, daily enrichment and exercise logs, medical records, intake procedures, and care protocols.
